title: Paarai
desc: Durai Raj, a lorry driver, has only one friend, Jayaram. However, when his friend dies, Durai Raj strives to support his family.

title: Oru Thaai Makkal
desc: A rich man adopts one of the twin sons of his maid after his own child dies. However, fate brings the brothers face to face when they both fall in love with the same woman.

title: Ponnana Neram
desc: A young college girl, who enjoys playing pranks on others, gets into trouble with a group of terrorists. A brave police officer comes to her rescue and sets on a mission to wipe out the gang.

title: Nadodi Thendral
desc: Thangarasu, a goldsmith's son, and Poonkuruvi, a gypsy and poultry seller, fall in love during the era of British rule. However, Thangarasu soon attracts the affections of a young English lady.

title: Simmasanam
desc: Sakthivel and Thangarasu are stepbrothers who don't get along with each other. Their differences become more apparent as they start finding out their father's killer.
